name: retry_off
description: Paired retry comparison: identical workload, seed, request ids and stand-in faults (8% transient 5xx; stand-in minute limits 40 RPM / 24000 TPM, tighter than the gate's 96 / 48000 so upstream minute 429s occur); only PAPERRELAY_RETRY_MAX differs. Outcome not presumed. Retries off (RETRY_MAX=0).
limits_note: Gate and stand-in minute limits are workload-scaled synthetic values (stand-in 120 RPM / 60000 TPM, gate at 80%), not real Groq limits, so a 3-minute run yields enough requests. Real header-advertised values are in experiments/limits_evidence.json.
